summary: DBV Technologies filed an 8-K announcing press release updates regarding its BLA submission for the VIASKIN Peanut Patch in children aged 4–7. The company is working collaboratively with the FDA to optimize the review process; no additional data requested. BLA filing anticipated in Q3 2026. No financial terms, board recommendations, or transactional mechanics disclosed. This is a regulatory pipeline update, not a special situation event.
